summary: Backend-only verification of POS registry → Google Sheet contract v1.4 compliance. 26/26 pytest tests passed. Verified: (a) live sheet 'All Items' — every non-blank Registered/Last updated/Closed cell matches ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ (0 violations); (b) BUG-448..BUG-453 and CR-386 Registered are clean leading dates (no prose); (c) BUG-466 and CR-391..CR-399 show Registered='2026-06-01' with Notes starting 'DATE APPROXIMATED (...month only → day 01).'; (d) all 5 INV-* items show Type='INV' and Type column contains only {BUG,CR,INV,INCIDENT,GAP}; (e) 10 tabs in exact contract order; 22-column header matches CONTRACT_COLS; Status is from 8-enum with 0 blanks; Priority in P0-P3 for open items; stage-tab row counts equal All Items status counts; Blockers tab has 0 CLOSED/PARKED/DUPLICATE; Assignee blank everywhere; (f) registry.json has 0 malformed date fields, INV items have type 'INV', _date_raw preserved for most targeted items; (g) idempotency — `--dry-run` reports Unclassified=0 and Change Log new=0, `--diff` prints 'No sheet edits since last push', `--pull` exits with 'disabled' message; (h) offline unit tests on diff_sheet/apply_change_log confirm: Status→PENDING, Title→REJECTED ('column not editable in Phase 1'), Priority→APPLIED (SOURCE=DASHBOARD), Assignee ignored (no CL row, captured in assignees dict), invalid Registered→REJECTED, apply_change_log APPROVED → APPLIED with status mutated. No live-sheet writes performed; registry.json untouched; --push NOT invoked.
critical_code_review_comments: sheets_sync.py is 737 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting classify_status/area normaliser/diff-apply into modules for maintainability.

diff_sheet treats a change log row where Decision=='APPLIED' + Note=='SOURCE=DASHBOARD' as 'fresh dashboard priority'; the check `not r[7].endswith('done')` relies on string suffix. A dedicated status (e.g., 'APPLIED_PENDING') would be clearer than overloading the Note column.

In `_clean_date_fields`, partial-date fallback silently drops any value that doesn't match either full date or YYYY-MM pattern (sets to ''). Consider warning/logging when dropped to catch future format drift.
`_build_type` upper-casing happens both in prepare_registry and _build_type; redundant but harmless.
No automated check that INV items added in future automatically map 'INVESTIGATION' → 'INV' at registry level (ensured only on prepare_registry run). Covered by _TYPE_MAP.
